# linux_file (Data Source)

Reads a file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linux_file" "os_release" {
  path = "/etc/os-release"
}

output "os_release" {
  value = data.linux_file.os_release.content
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Absolute path of the file.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Content of the file, as text.
- `content_base64` (String) Content of the file, base64-encoded.
- `group` (String) Group name, or GID when it has none.
- `id` (String) Path of the file.
- `mode` (String) Permissions, as four octal digits.
- `owner` (String) Owner name, or UID when it has none.
- `sha256` (String) SHA-256 digest of the content, hex-encoded.
